name: How do I ensure quality workmanship in my roof replacement scope?

mainEntity.name: How do I ensure quality workmanship in my roof replacement scope?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ensuring quality workmanship in your roof replacement scope involves selecting a reputable contractor, reviewing their past work, and understanding their warranty. Look for contractors with established local presence, positive reviews, and proper licensing and insurance. A detailed contract that specifies materials, installation methods, and a clear timeline is also essential. Additionally, inquire about manufacturer warranties on materials and the contractor's workmanship warranty to protect your investment post-installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ensure quality by choosing a reputable, licensed contractor with good reviews, a detailed contract, and comprehensive material and workmanship warranties.
